description: R1 — repaired debugger interaction v2: same frozen RAW Qwen2.5-Coder-7B model, same task, same budgets as D1/S1, with the repaired model-facing interface (source + breakpoint-eligible lines, source rendering, error diagnostics, lifecycle visibility).

interface_repairs.a_source_visibility: Production target source with line numbers and breakpoint-eligible lines shown at the break decision point.
interface_repairs.b_source_rendering: get_source_window observations render actual source lines, not just the summary string.
interface_repairs.c_error_diagnostics: Bounded/redacted ToolExecutionError diagnostics propagated and rendered in error observations.
interface_repairs.d_tool_execution_diagnostic: ToolExecutionError carries safe_diagnostic; dispatch extracts it through the existing bounded/redacted safety pipeline.
interface_repairs.e_lifecycle_visibility: Debugger lifecycle state (NOT_STARTED/PAUSED/CONSUMED_OR_ENDED) shown; only lifecycle-legal commands advertised.

treatment.forced_runtime_entry: Administrative REPRODUCE->UNDERSTAND->RUNTIME_EVIDENCE navigation after verified reproduction (reused from D1).
treatment.breakpoint_affordance: compile()+co_lines() derived, production-only, non-oracle. Module-definition lines excluded. Harness driver lines excluded by construction.

source_baseline.note: R1 descends from the accepted S1 source. The old D1 evidence is preserved immutably.
